scope: Validated ABI type/value pairs, bounded defaults and integer bounds; regression for Chromium profile cleanup race

ci_failure_fixed.symptom: IndexedDB assertions passed, then rmtree encountered a child file removed by Chromium
ci_failure_fixed.fix: Retry ENOENT while the owned root exists, as well as ENOTEMPTY; preserve permission failures and bounded retries

limitations: Typed defaults and integer limits deliberately correct pinned reference constant-zero stubs.
ABI values use explicit types and positional tuples; runtime coercions and JS branding are not mirrored.
Bounded sanitizer runs are not independent security qualification.
